title: primulina rongshuiensis
intro: Primulina rongshuiensis, commonly known as the Rongshui primulina, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Gesneriaceae family. It is an herb used in traditional Chinese medicine, known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antiviral properties. The therapeutic actions of Primulina rongshuiensis include reducing fever, alleviating pain, and soothing respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
